product_overview: A backend API to manage users (registration, approval, roles) and to assign/track tasks with JWT-based authentication and role-based access control.
core_goals: Provide secure user registration and login with JWT authentication.
Support employee lifecycle: registration, pending approval, role-based access, and listing.
Enable task creation, assignment and retrieval for users, with endpoints for both global and per-user task views.
Enforce role-based access control so HR/Admin can approve users and access pending lists while regular users access only allowed resources.
Offer clear API error responses for common failure modes (validation, authentication, authorization, not found).

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allow users to register, login to receive a JWT, and check account status by email.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid payload (name, email, password, role) -> Receive 201 with created user id and status 'pending'
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/status/:email with no auth required -> Receive 200 with account status (e.g., 'pending' or 'active')
POST /api/auth/register with missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Employee Management
features.description: Admin/HR can view pending employees, approve them, and retrieve employee lists; authenticated users can view allowed employee lists per role.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/employees/pending with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list of pending employees -> PUT /api/employees/:id/approve with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid employee id -> Receive 200 with updated employee status 'active' -> GET /api/employees with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with employees list including approved employee
POST /api/auth/login with regular user credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/employees/pending with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 403 forbidden (insufficient role)
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/employees/:nonexistentId/approve with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Create tasks assigned to users, list all tasks (authorized) and list tasks for the logged-in user.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/tasks with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid payload (title, description, assigneeId) -> Receive 201 with created task id -> POST /api/auth/login with assignee credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/tasks/my-tasks with Authorization: Bearer <assignee token> -> Receive 200 with list including the new task
GET /api/tasks without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/tasks with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid assigneeId -> Receive 400 or 404 validation error
